tests.1: Keep the next node before relinking cur.next, or the rest of the list is lost.
tests.2: One node: the reversed list is the same node.
tests.3: After reversing, the old head is the new tail: its next must become empty.

runtime: The recursive reverse needs a base case for the last node; the iterative one stops when cur is empty.
timeout: A loop that never ends usually means a node still points back into the list: set the old head's next to empty.
